stem.en: The graph shows the velocity-time line of a scooter. Use the area under the line to find its displacement from t = 0 s to t = 4 s, in m.

explanation.en: The velocity rises from 4 m/s to 16 m/s in 4 s. Split the area: a rectangle 4 m/s x 4 s = 16 m, and a triangle 1/2 x 4 s x 12 m/s = 24 m. Displacement = 16 m + 24 m = 40 m.

hints.en: Split the area into a rectangle under 4 m/s and a triangle on top.
